source.title: Introduction and open problems of Donaldson-Thomas theory

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/6242531 with trailing identifier 6242531. Local shard metadata in outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-0.csv identifies the same source URL, year 2012, title, and DOI 10.4171/115-1/11.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted plus metadata_only, with network_or_dns_failure for local shell fetches. The EMS Press landing page for DOI 10.4171/115-1/11 confirms the exact chapter title, author Yukinobu Toda, pages 287-318, and abstract, but reports that a subscription is required to access the book chapter PDF. The zbMATH page did not expose a readable record or full-text body in the browser fetch, and local shell fetching of zbmath.org and api.zbmath.org failed with DNS resolution errors.

Bounded exact-work searches attempted the zbMATH identifier, exact DOI, exact title, exact title plus PDF, and exact title plus author. Candidate pages inspected or identified were the EMS Press chapter page and PDF endpoint, EMS Press contents/API metadata pages, MAA book table of contents, KAKEN project metadata, AMS/JAMS citation snippets, and Scribd/SlideShare user-uploaded book mirrors. These candidates were rejected because they were subscription-restricted, metadata-only, table-of-contents or citation-only pages, search snippets, third-party mirrors that were not accepted as source-authorized primary artifacts, or different works. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the chapter's problem statements was recovered.

Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source. No questions were extracted from metadata, abstracts, search snippets, title text, related papers, or non-source-authorized mirrors.
Saved exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/6242531.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
